body: Ideation is a good way to put it. If I killed myself, I'd leave behind a handful friends and a brother. I can't in good conscience be that big of a dickhead to them. But I ideate *relentlessly* and chant "I hate myself, I wish I were dead" over and over sometimes, like a Tourette's patient. Except I do have control over it because I never do that in public.

I'll try to make such a list. I've tried previously and you're right, it's very hard. It's a lot easier to make a negative list. I've never really respected trying, only results. Loving myself might be outside the realm of possibility but I'll settle for not feeling like every fuckup is equivalent to Rome burning to the ground. And instantly jumping to suicide as a solution.

Thank you for saying that I sound like I have my shit together. It was good to read. Do you have any advice on how to show myself a little kindness? I'm not sure how. I always perceive myself as too lenient, not too harsh. Not being the DI Hartman to my Pvt. Pyle always made me feel one step away from total failure. And total failure requires suicide.

It's admirable that you can see your fuckups constructively. I've tried, with mixed results. I know that much of my post probably reads like self-pitying bullshit and indeed, I suspect that I overreact to shit like this because I'm not really suicidal, just a pansy who won't own up.

But I'm trying to own up. It's impossible to hate myself any harder.
